candidates.formal_type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] (p : Nat) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP.{u_1} k p]
  (V : Type u_2) [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V] [inst_5 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k V]
  [inst_6 : Module.{u_1, u_2} (Etingof.WeylAlgebra.{u_1} k) V]
  [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (Etingof.WeylAlgebra.{u_1} k) V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k V]
  [IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} (Etingof.WeylAlgebra.{u_1} k) V],
  Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun α =>
    Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun c =>
      Exists.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)} fun b =>
        And
          (∀ (i : Fin p),
            Eq.{u_2 + 1}
              (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_2, u_2} (Etingof.WeylAlgebra.x.{u_1} k)
                (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), 1, u_2 + 1} b i))
              (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_2, u_2} (ite.{u_1 + 1} (Eq.{1} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1) 0) α 1)
                (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), 1, u_2 + 1} b (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1))))
          (∀ (i : Fin p),
            Eq.{u_2 + 1}
              (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_2, u_2} (Etingof.WeylAlgebra.y.{u_1} k)
                (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), 1, u_2 + 1} b (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1)))
              (HAdd.hAdd.{u_2, u_2, u_2}
                (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_2, u_2} c
                  (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), 1, u_2 + 1} b (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1)))
                (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_2, u_2} (Nat.cast.{u_1} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i.val 1))
                  (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), 1, u_2 + 1} b i))))

source_text: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p, an irreducible finite-dimensional module has the orbit basis v,xv,...,x^(p-1)v and the corresponding cyclic-shift/lowering normal form.
